narration.text: In Luppolandia, a notice is nailed to the tavern door. It smells of hops and fresh ink: Wanted — brave (or desperate) heroes. Black rats the size of dogs in the cellar. Good pay, free beer. Ask Glowkindle — The Wizard's Tower Brewing Co.

choices.label: Take the job for the gold
Go — the Tashalar Pale Ale has vanished from every tap

narration.text: A messenger shrugs. Glowkindle pays well, but he says the rats down there watch you. I wouldn't go sober — and I've lived in Luppolandia forever.

choices.label: Climb the hill to the brewery

narration.text: The dirt road climbs past hedges and hay. Malt on the wind — and older stone. At the hilltop: grey stone, two barns, a creaking sign. A rock gnome in green braces shoves a mug into your hands. Drink. It's Tashalar Pale Ale — the last I've got. Then we talk. Make the beasts disappear. Find where they come from. Until something moves below, I don't reopen the vats. Seventy-five gold each. Beer for a month. Old gold you find is yours — I just want to sleep without squeaking.

choices.label: Accept the vague mission (75 gp each)

narration.text: Glowkindle waves a hand. Stones. Old ones. I was making room for barrels. Then — them. I don't know if it's an ancient cellar or a well or a graveyard of rats. I don't go down anymore. Priority: sleep without squeaking.

choices.label: Take the job — open the trapdoor

narration.text: Behind the bar, Glowkindle lifts a jute rug and a hidden trapdoor. Stone stairs sink into a buried wizard's tower. Dust. Cold. He stays above. If you hear something… don't call me. Or do. I don't know. Go.

A dusty stone corridor opens beyond the stairs. Footsteps echo a breath too late. A mosaic of colored tiles covers the runner like a cursed chessboard. Side doors lead into dark. At the far end: a heavy iron door with three empty sockets. Beside the jamb, a hole in the floor breathes warm air — something has been climbing out to hunt.
The mosaic corridor is your hub. Side doors: Cellar, Well, Store. The iron laboratory door waits for three seals. The threshold hole ticks with distant claws. Choose where to press next.

A poem is scratched beside the mosaic:

The amethyst tear that metal scratches and does not crush,
the cold ash of a fire that is no more,
the deep abyss where light dies,
the wound of the sky before the horizon falls silent.

Touch four tiles in order. Color is enough.
Four lights bloom on the mosaic. The corridor feels open as a true hub. No seal — only passage.
A second fault wakes the corridor blades — they scythe the air (Dexterity save DC 14, 2d10 slashing, half on success). The mosaic still yields if you force the correct colors afterward.
Bloodied but stubborn, you press Violet, Grey, Black, Red. The blades freeze. The hub is yours.
Three empty seal sockets stare from the iron door. Cold to the touch. The hole beside the jamb exhales warm, foul air — proof the source lies beyond. You need the Cellar, Well, and Store seals.

The Cellar smells of old oak and animal musk. Barrels crowd the walls. Something moves behind them — not one rat. A pack holding its breath. Niches wait with carved vessel marks: Eye, X, Wave, Spiral.
Order of the Vessels. An inscription lists constraints — not the order. Four niches: Eye, X, Wave, Spiral. Touch them in the true sequence.

puzzle.hint: True order: Eye → X → Wave → Spiral.

narration.text: The Eye niche vibrates. A stone slab detaches with a dull crack — the Seal of the Cellar.
Wrong order. Heat blooms from the sockets — fire washes the hall (Dexterity save DC 13, 2d8 fire). You jam a crowbar and force the slab free: Seal of the Cellar, scorched but yours.

A stone well with a rotten rope and pulley. Daylight leaks from a ceiling crack and snuffs torches as if it hates them. Two carvings on the rim: one lists four lock marks; the other reads — The weight that sinks to the bottom breaks the seal of the deep.
Four sockets, too many symbols. The carving whispers: First what bites the rope; then the fallen star; then the eye of the night sky; finally what has no shape and yet flows.
The lock clicks. The pulley runs free. Lower the bucket to claim the seal.
Too much noise. Centipedes boil from the dark below the rim!
You lower the bucket. It kisses the bottom with a muffled thud. Stone on the rim splits open — the Seal of the Well.

choices.label: Take the Seal of the Well and return

narration.text: A narrow alchemical store of the tower: shelves of unbroken glass, green, amber, black vials like glass eyes. Tiny rat prints in the dust. On the bench: a wizard's note and three empty basins for an interrupted ritual. No vault here — the Door of Three Seals is on the Laboratory.
Four vials in a row (α β γ δ). Constraints: two Healing vials are not adjacent; Invisibility sits immediately left of Vitality; α is not Vitality; δ is not Invisibility. Deduce — do not taste.

puzzle.hint: Place α→δ: Healing, Invisibility, Vitality, Healing.

narration.text: The vials lock into place with a soft chime. The basins awaken for Phase B — the Residue Mixture.
Acid fumes lash the store (Dexterity save DC 13, 2d8 acid). Coughing, you still force the correct arrangement and reach the basins.

Three gestures for the seal of my study: question objects under a sunless sky → a border against spirits → anoint the slabs. Basin I, II, III. Fourteen reagents glitter — only three are true. The note never says the words moon, salt, or oil.

puzzle.hint: True mixture: Moon Dust → Black Salt → Stone Oil.

narration.text: The mixture settles. From the basin floor rises a slab — the Seal of the Residue.
Wrong reagents flash — a catalyst bloom of fire and acid. You smother it and scrape the Seal of the Residue free.
The threshold hole spat two giant rats — an omen. The source still lies beyond the iron door. The corridor hub waits.
Giant centipedes fall still. Burnt hair lines the hole's rim. Two seals done — one remains, or the laboratory if you already hold three.
You bind wounds in the mosaic dust. Glowkindle left nothing this deep — only grit and resolve. Ready for the next door.
Three seals slide into the sockets — Cellar, Well, Residue. The Door of Three Seals shudders. Mechanisms grind. The iron vault unlocks with a sound like a held breath released.
Cracked glass. Scorched tables. Something large waits on the ceiling. Silk glints with embers. The threshold hole behind you goes… listening.

choices.label: Step in and face it now

narration.text: You steal a short rest on the vault threshold. Potions from Glowkindle's stair cache still warm your packs. The silk above shifts impatiently.
The Infernal Spider collapses. Through the hole by the iron door you glimpse a cuniculus leading back toward this lab — and it goes silent. The source is dead. Time to climb toward beer and gold…
The mosaic corridor glows orange. Fur and lava block the runner. A Magma Rat the size of a hound grins with molten teeth — the exit tax of Luppolandia.

Glowkindle meets you with shaking hands and full mugs. The squeaking is gone. Seventy-five gold each, beer for a month — and the last of the Tashalar Pale Ale tastes like victory with a metallic aftertaste only Luppolandia knows.
